trumpWatch.title: Summit eve: Bessent-He Lifeng formalize 'USA-China AI dialogues'; critical minerals on the table
trumpWatch.detail: Sunday's meeting at JPMorgan HQ in New York produced a formal AI track: an incident hotline plus agreed protocols on leading AI dangers (uncontrollable agents, non-state cyber/bio actors); next round in China in two months. Critical-mineral supply chains discussed; Chinese officials did not clarify their export position — a live failure script. Xi-Trump summit runs Sep 24-25 in Washington.

trumpWatch.title: Trump at UNGA: Iran deal 'right after the midterms'; Cuba delegation walks out
trumpWatch.detail: Trump defended joining Israel's military action against Iran but said he believes the US reaches a deal with Iran right after the November midterms; 'more oil is flowing than at any point since the war began... prices will plummet once the conflict is over'; warned no threats to America will gain a foothold in the Western Hemisphere; the Cuban delegation walked out as he said 'Cuba will fall'. Iran's armed forces called the remarks 'tools of domestic propaganda'; Fars source: 'Iran is ready for all existing scenarios'.

trumpWatch.title: Oil breaks lower on US/Iran diplomacy: WTI settles -$1.85 at $90.52
trumpWatch.detail: Newsquawk crude wrap Tuesday: WTI (X6) settles $1.85 lower at $90.52/bbl, Brent (Z6) $0.83 lower at $95.41; US stocks opened with marginal gains 'as crude falls on US/Iran diplomacy hopes'. First sustained crack below the war-premium range — a different inflation input for rates and metals.

trumpWatch.title: Trump on AI: threat warnings 'a hoax' — 'I will only encourage AI or, SI (SUPER INTELLIGENCE)!'
trumpWatch.detail: Monday Truth Social post locks in the anti-regulation posture ahead of the summit's AI track: 'We are leading now over China, and everyone else, and I'm going to keep it that way!... I will only encourage AI or, SI (SUPER INTELLIGENCE)!' Administration officials signal openness to AI-safety involvement only if Beijing matches it.

trumpWatch.title: Fed cross-currents: Collins hawkish vs Barkin 'mid-cycle'; markets expect at least one more hike
trumpWatch.detail: Collins (2028 voter) reiterates support for last week's hike, sees increased likelihood inflation stays notably above 2%; Barkin (2027) hopes for a '1990s mid-cycle adjustment', labor not overheated; Goolsbee: can't overlook persistent supply shocks; Musalem: further increases may be needed. $69bn 2yr auction Tuesday; 10y at 4.97%.

trumpWatch.title: Elsewhere: Lavrov-Rubio call; Canada targets Israeli settlement goods; Honda halts Canada EV plant
trumpWatch.detail: Lavrov and Rubio held a phone call Tuesday (RIA) ahead of the summit; Canada announced restrictions on Israeli settlement goods plus $71M Palestine aid (Carney); Honda put its Canada EV-factory plans on hold. Wednesday's slate: global flash PMIs, SARB decision, Trump-Sharif meeting and Pezeshkian's UNGA address; Thursday: Xi-Trump plus Norges/Riksbank/SNB/Banxico.
